tools.description: Change a draft made with create_draft (the same link stays): send only what changes; null takes a field back to the template's.

tools.name: get_draft
tools.description: What a draft holds: its template, format, values, what is missing, its studio link and its price.

tools.description: The Pro templates: designed videos in 16:9 and 9:16 whose every text, image and color an agent can change for a brand. Each lists its length and formats.

tools.name: create_pro_draft
tools.description: Make a draft of a Pro template with the brand's texts, images and colors: set (a layer's text, its image src and fit, its colors, or hidden), recolor (one palette color to another everywhere) and video (its background). The layout, timing and motion stay the template's: an operation that changes the

tools.name: edit_pro_draft
tools.description: Change a Pro draft's texts, images and colors (the same operations as create_pro_draft: set, recolor, video's background). Send revision to be sure nobody changed it since you read it (a stale one is refused). Returns the new revision and warnings.

tools.name: get_pro_draft
tools.description: A Pro draft as it is now: its revision, every layer (what differs per format) and both formats' docs.

tools.name: upload_pro_image
tools.description: Store an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG) in a Pro draft and get its src for an image layer ({"op":"set","layer":"hero","props":{"src":"<src>"}}). Send small images as data (base64 or a data URL, up to 3 MB); for a file on disk, leave data out and the answer is the curl command that uploads it.

tools.name: look_at_pro_draft
tools.description: Render stills (or a contact sheet) of a Pro draft as it is now, in each format, and return them as images inside the answer, with a layout check of those moments by layer (text hidden under another layer, past its box, low contrast). Look before you hand the link over; change and look again.

tools.name: look_at_draft
tools.description: Render stills (or a contact sheet) of a catalog draft with its texts, images and adjustments, the way its export will, and return them as images inside the answer with a layout check of those moments.

tools.name: get_frames
tools.description: The images of a look that wasn't ready when it was asked (look_at_draft or look_at_pro_draft answered a jobId).

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "join_studio_session" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: upload_pro_image · Private data: media_upload_command, upload_pro_image, look_at_pro_draft, look_at_draft · Public sink: update_draft, media_upload_command, edit_pro_draft, upload_pro_image · Destructive: get_draft, media_upload_command, get_pro_template, get_pro_draft, look_at_pro_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: upload_pro_image · Private data: media_upload_command, upload_pro_image, look_at_pro_draft, look_at_draft · Public sink: update_draft, media_upload_command, edit_pro_draft, upload_pro_image · Destructive: get_draft, media_upload_command, get_pro_template, get_pro_draft, look_at_pro_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
